responsibility: Defines expand-module data shared across macro expansion and downstream compiler crates, primarily by re-exporting expansion support submodules and by providing `StrippedCfgItem`, the portable record used to track items removed by `cfg` evaluation together with their parent module, name, and controlling configuration.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `attr/mod.rs`, this `mod.rs` is an expansion-facing shared entry point with very little AST logic of its own: it re-exports expansion support submodules and defines `StrippedCfgItem` for cfg-removed items. It does not parse or manage attributes; instead it only references `MetaItem` from `attr/mod.rs` as one field in that shared record.
